# HOKKAIDO LOVE!

> > Official Hokkaido tourism portal featuring travel information, seasonal festivals, regional attractions, and transportation guides across Japan's northernmost island.

HOKKAIDO LOVE! is the official tourism website operated by Hokkaido Tourism Organization, providing comprehensive travel resources for exploring Hokkaido's diverse regions including Sapporo, Otaru, Kushiro, and remote islands like Rishiri. The site covers seasonal events, natural attractions, hot springs, local gourmet experiences, and detailed transportation options including JR Hokkaido rail services, ferries, and scenic trains.

## Key Topics

- Hokkaido tourism and travel planning
- Sapporo city attractions and events
- Seasonal festivals (snow, flower, summer)
- Odori Park and public spaces
- JR Hokkaido rail network
- New Chitose Airport access
- Otaru canal district
- Hot springs (onsen) experiences
- Local gourmet and seafood
- Tanukikoji Shopping Arcade
- AOAO Sapporo aquarium
- Kushiro wetlands and nature
- Ferry and inter-regional transportation
- Cherry blossom and flower viewing
- Winter illuminations and ice festivals

## Getting Started

- [Official Hokkaido Tourism Site](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp): Official Hokkaido tourism site with attractions, hot springs & gourmet

## Transportation & Access

- [Access to Hokkaido from Japan](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/access/to_hokkaido_1_1_3.html): Access guide to Hokkaido from Japan via flights, trains & ferries
- [Inter-Regional Transportation](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/access/in_hokkaido_1_6_6.html): Transportation guide for traveling between Hokkaido regions and cities
- [Ferry, Bus & Rental Car Options](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/access/list_1_2______%E3%83%95%E3%82%A7%E3%83%AA%E3%83%BC__.html): Ferry, bus & rental car transportation options for Hokkaido travel
- [Kushiro Wetland Norokko Train](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/access/detail_10126.html): Kushiro Wetland Norokko scenic train guide through Japan's largest marsh

## Sapporo Festivals & Events

- [Sapporo White Illumination](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/cn/event/detail_11003.html): Sapporo White Illumination winter light festival at Odori Park
- [Sapporo Summer Festival](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/cn/event/detail_11008.html): Sapporo Summer Festival with beer garden, Obon dance & Tanuki Matsuri
- [Sapporo Lilac Festival](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/cn/event/detail_11056.html): Sapporo Lilac Festival at Odori Park celebrating city's symbolic flower
- [Susukino Festival](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/cn/event/detail_10009.html): Susukino Festival in Sapporo with geisha parades & taiko performances

## Seasonal Flower Festivals

- [Hokuryu Sunflower Festival](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/cn/event/detail_10016.html): Hokuryu sunflower festival with 2M blooms across 23 hectares
- [Shizunai Cherry Blossom Festival](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/cn/event/detail_10051.html): Shizunai cherry blossom festival on 7km road with 2,000+ sakura trees
- [Takikawa Rapeseed Flower Festival](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/cn/event/detail_10532.html): Takikawa rapeseed flower festival in May with vast yellow fields

## Regional Events

- [Otaru Ushio Festival](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/cn/event/detail_11009.html): Otaru Ushio Festival in July with fireworks over Otaru Port
- [Shimokawa Ice Candle Museum](https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/cn/event/detail_11034.html): Shimokawa Ice Candle Museum winter event in February, birthplace of ice candles
